title: 第14章 水妖上岸
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

虽然还可以凝聚血煞，经验丰富，但身体机能下降，对于人境武士当然还有明显优势，但对上别的地境，怕是都过不了十招，就会气血衰败。

而除了谢太公之外，现在的长溪部还有三名正处于青壮年的地境武士，比之三十年前还是要强不少的，若是将当年那只蛟蟒放到现在，完全有当场直接镇压的可能。

不过可惜的是，局势还在朝着所有人都不愿意看到的方向发展。

第二天，雨依旧是丝毫没有减小的迹象。

于是乎，天刚亮，祁云就已经将城内的几个主官给叫了过来。

前堂的铜盆里，炭火熊熊燃烧，为这晨光暗淡的造成提供着光亮与温暖。

除了上卿巫祭谢颂，亚卿司马祁虎，剩下的，则是担任司农、司空、司寇等职位的几名上大夫。

“来了？”祁云抬了下巴，“人都到齐了，你说。”

祁澜也不客气，走到铺在案上的兽皮地图前，拿起一根木棍开口道：

“城东的黄土岗，土质黏实，最适合做坝料，劳虎叔遣士卒五百，押送城中奴隶掘土，用牛车转运到南堤和东堤。”

木棍一移，指向司农、司空等官。

“石料、木料出库！发动国人编织竹笼，填装碎石，与木排一同垒在堤脚，此事由司徒、司农主持！”

“城外西南低洼处开掘泄洪渠，一旦发水，便可引水到荒地去，以免毁坏大水摧毁国中大片农田，此事，由司空与虎叔助我，兵营之中也要抽调人手。”

“最后，抽调以人境武士为主的军中精锐为主，随我父上堤巡防，沿湖设哨，架构防线，。”

这些事，昨夜祁澜就已经和祁云、谢太公商讨完毕了。

主要是依照他所说的那四点，进行完善补充。

祁云双手负背，看着面前的几个邦国的高级官员，开口道：“去办吧，告诉国人，征发期间，每人每日，皆有肉羹可食，事后每户多发一月口粮。”

这话一出，司农等官便不再多言，拱手退下安排。

一炷香后，长溪邑内的铜钟被连着敲响了三遍。

大夫、士人、国人、附庸、奴隶，按户编队，扛着锄头、铲子、扁担，汇成洪流，涌出城门。

祁澜亲自带着祁虎和大批士卒，赶到西南低洼处，由巫祭谢颂和负责国中各项工程的司空，勘定了两条泄洪渠的走向。

雨还在下。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Although he can still condense blood demons and has rich experience, his body function has declined. Of course, he still has obvious advantages over human realm warriors, but against other realms, he may not be able to pass ten moves before his energy and blood will decline.

In addition to Taigong Xie, the current Changxi tribe also has three warriors who are in their prime. They are still much stronger than they were thirty years ago. If the python from back then was placed now, it is entirely possible to directly suppress it on the spot.

But unfortunately, the situation is still developing in a direction that no one wants to see.

The next day, the rain still showed no sign of abating.

As a result, at dawn, Qi Yun had already called several chief officials in the city.

In the copper basin in the front hall, charcoal fire burned brightly, providing light and warmth to the dim morning light.

Except for Xie Song, the witch priest of Shangqing, and Sima Qihu of Yaqing, the rest are several senior officials who hold positions such as Sinong, Sikong, and Sikou.

"Coming?" Qi Yun raised his chin, "Everyone is here, tell me."

Qi Lan was not polite, walked to the animal skin map spread on the table, picked up a wooden stick and said:

"The loess hills in the east of the city have clayey soil, which is most suitable for dam materials. Uncle Laohu sent five hundred soldiers to escort the slaves in the city to dig the soil, and transport it to the South Embankment and East Embankment in oxcarts."

The wooden stick moved and pointed at Si Nong, Sikong and other officials.

"Stones and wood are out of the warehouse! Mobilize the Chinese people to weave bamboo cages, fill them with gravel, and build them at the foot of the embankment together with wooden rafts. Situ and Sinong are in charge of this matter!"

"Dig a flood channel in the low-lying area in the southwest outside the city. Once flooded, the water can be diverted to the wasteland to prevent the flood from destroying the large farmland in the country. Sikong and Uncle Hu will help me with this matter, and manpower will also be deployed in the military camp."

"Finally, the elite military personnel, mainly Human Realm warriors, will be mobilized to follow my father on patrol on the embankment, set up sentries along the lake, and build a defense line."

Qi Lan had already discussed these matters with Qi Yun and Taigong Xie last night.

Mainly based on the four points he mentioned, we will make improvements and supplements.

Qi Yun put his hands behind his back, looked at the senior officials of several countries in front of him, and said: "Go and do it. Tell the people that during the conscription period, everyone will have meat soup to eat every day. Afterwards, each household will be given an extra month of rations."

As soon as these words came out, Si Nong and other officials stopped talking and made arrangements.

After lighting the incense, the bronze bell in Changxi City was rung three times in a row.

Officials, scholars, countrymen, vassals, and slaves formed groups according to households, carrying hoes, shovels, and poles. They formed a torrent and poured out of the city gate.

Qi Lan personally led Qi Hu and a large number of soldiers to the low-lying area in the southwest. Xie Song, the witch priest, and Sikong, who was in charge of various projects in the country, determined the direction of the two flood discharge channels.

It's still raining.
